ai_briefing.morning_summary: Crypto majors posted modest gains on the Delta India exchange, with BTC up 0.65% and ETH up 1% while most altcoins followed suit. Market focus shifts to regulatory headlines, notably the push for SCOTUS to address prediction markets and the IMF’s warning on tokenized‑stock volatility. New token listings on Delta India add fresh liquidity but are unlikely to move the broader market today.
